name: recovery-guardian
description: Recovery controller with append-only anti-loop history and live GitHub reconstruction for interrupted Project Leader workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Recovers interrupted project workflows and prevents duplicate retries.
interface.longDescription: Use Recovery Guardian after a failed, interrupted, looping, or ambiguous Project Leader execution. It reconstructs durable state from GitHub, verifies whether writes already happened before retrying, breaks no-progress loops, resumes only inside existing authorization, and preserves all human gates.
